quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton needs weapons and chemistry to return to greatness
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Haliburton is a pass-first guy, he needs those type of weapons around him
quotes.quote: It is going to take a while to return to any type of greatness. This is not going to be like re-signing LeBron. Tyrese Haliburton is a pass-first guy, he needs those type of weapons around him and he also needs that type of chemistry. I do not want to put that much pressure on somebody that right now should only have pressure on himself to finish the season healthy. They are going to be loads better than they were last year. The needle definitely moves now that he is there.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's competitive nature will energize the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: When Jimmy is healthy, his competitive nature is something that can energize the team.
quotes.quote: When Jimmy is healthy, his competitive nature is something that can energize the team. His ability to attract a double team, his ability to play with his back to the basket is something that calls for the playoffs. So him coming around January or February, all us league veterans know that is the perfect time to be coming back right after All-Star. Get your feet wet, start really getting those reps in, really getting those games in toward the end of the year.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's decline has caused the Warriors to lose their spark
quotes.excerpt: I felt like the Warriors lose their spark because Draymond is on the later parts of his career.
quotes.quote: I felt like the Warriors lose their spark because Draymond is on the later parts of his career. I think that the Warriors team, it was underestimated how much Draymond as the engine of that team meant until now when you are watching a decrease. Because you are not watching a Steph Curry that still cannot get the job done. I think you are just watching a much different nucleus in a team to where it is not really built for Steph.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's return will help Cooper Flagg's development
quotes.excerpt: I think the Mavs do get a whole lot better once Kyrie returns
quotes.quote: I think the Mavs do get a whole lot better once Kyrie returns because Cooper Flagg has had to shoulder a lot of that responsibility. But I think that shouldering that responsibility did a lot more for him than we all saw.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: J. Kidd's coaching style and player management

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: It is because of how he was talking. He was talking reckless. J. Kidd was and he was just talking. I get it, but they are like, man, we are trying to do something different. We are trying to turn this thing around. Let us do it, and we are trying to make the playoffs and this guy out here just like, no, no. He is our guy. Like, y'all want us to save him for games? I am not doing that. Y'all want us to wait for playoffs? I am not doing that.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Got to fall in line at some point. That is all I am saying, J. Kidd. We want to keep you in the league. I love J. Kidd, love him even more. That is why we love you, J. Kidd. Have a back bone, bro.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Former players are skipping the assistant coach route to head coaching
quotes.excerpt: I think you are starting to see people skip the earn the keep part
quotes.quote: I think the league has been the league for as long as it has because you still have guys that were part of the organizations that were part of this league. They usually do get introduced to jobs after basketball, staying around player development, being assistant coaches, earning their keep and then transitioning into head coaches. I think that because we have seen the success of former players winning championships within their early coming into a head coach, I think you are starting to see people skip the earn the keep part where they got to be an assistant for 10 years.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The media space is changing how players communicate with fans
quotes.excerpt: The media space is where I feel like the player's voice is kind of changing everything.
quotes.quote: The media space is where I feel like the player's voice is kind of changing everything. Being able to talk direct to people and let them know what is going on, adding context to things, being able to explain when a player is in the mode right now and they cannot explain it. But it is like we see something getting ready to bubble and go, we can step in and protect that player, protect that thought, protect that game.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Players can provide context to online criticism
quotes.excerpt: There is no he say, she say. The players that are currently playing can look at it.
quotes.quote: There is no he say, she say. The players that are currently playing can look at it and say, well he was not saying that in a hateful way or he does not not like me, he is just saying this is where I can improve and this is where I will be better. They know he has been in the game, so he knows he is not trying to shit on my game, he is trying to improve it.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential of the Damian Lillard and Ja Morant duo

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I like Trey Young and AD, but I ain't going to lie, I am kind of scared of Damian Lillard and Ja Morant.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That is my thing. I really want to go with the Anthony Davis and Trey Young. Really do. That is my gut feeling. But I cannot bet against Dame. I just can't.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The defensive challenges of a three-guard lineup
quotes.excerpt: They might run that Illinois offense and just have three guards out there.
quotes.quote: If CJ and Dame was hell, that was hell to deal with. That is fucking hell. Are you telling me that now Dame has somebody that is just hyper athletic doing all the dunks that he wants to see? They might run that Illinois offense and just have three guards out there. You hear me? They might bust that, they might bust it. They might just say, fuck it, and once in a while just go out here and go athletic.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday is a perfect balance for any team
quotes.excerpt: Jrue Holiday is a great balance for any team. He is one of those perfect pieces.
quotes.quote: I like that Portland team what they got going, especially with Jrue Holiday. Jrue Holiday is a great balance for any team. He is one of those perfect pieces that just, he makes your chessboard look so much better.
